notes.title: Bud Blitz v1.0.2 released!
notes.notes:
Bud Blitz v1.0.2 has just went live!

Changelog:

- fixed a bug that caused planting/harvesting to continue after player stepped off button while swinging the hammer
- fixed a bug that caused rat eyes to remain visible in blood particles if rat sobered up while dying
- fixed a bug that caused Steam usernames containing spaces to be displayed incorrectly
- added a Hammer/Spiked Hammer reticle that can be toggled by pressing "R" while in game
- lowered "Kill X Wasps" Objective/Steam Achievement targets
- resized leaderboard display to accommodate longer usernames
- Grow Stations now become transparent when attacked from behind
- bud removal sprites can no longer be obscured by plant leaves
- FPS Display can be toggled by pressing "F" while in game
- high score panels now default to global leaderboard rather than local
- updated How To Play panel
- various performance improvements

This is a QOL update based on feedback received since launch. The hammer, while intentionally challenging, was found to be a bit too difficult for some players to use. I've added a toggleable reticle, activated by pressing R, which can help you get a feel for its range. Also, Grow Stations now become transparent when a rat attacks from behind which makes it easier to line up your attack. See the changelog above for additional changes.

I hope you enjoy the update and I'm always open to your suggestions!

--Dave
www.davebrakecreations.com
